name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
title: Supriya Lifescience Ltd - 543434 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR828 crores (+19%) and 35.5% EBITDA margin, but capacity build is ahead of demand: utilisation near 76%, debtor and inventory days rising, and FY27 growth guided as non-linear.

utilisation.quote: capacity utilization, I think we are around 76%

capex.quote: a large portion of the capex would be put up for Patalganga to the tune of about INR200 crores in the next 2 years

triggers.label: Utilisation ~76%, debottlenecking underway
triggers.quote: we are doing a lot of debottlenecking activities, and that's one of the reasons why we are taking the shutdown in quarter 2

triggers.label: Inventory days near 200
triggers.quote: inventory days have been running at close to 200 days for 2 years now

triggers.label: Raw-material increases passed to customers
triggers.quote: we were able to pass them on to our customers, because we work with customers on a purchase order basis

triggers.label: INR1,000 cr FY27 revenue reiterated
triggers.quote: Our trajectory towards the INR1,000 crores revenue milestone by financial year '27 remains firmly on track

guidance.quote: Our trajectory towards the INR1,000 crores revenue milestone by financial year '27 remains firmly on track
We iterate our guidance of approximately 20% annual growth revenue and EBITDA margin, 33% to 35%.
the margin would be around 33% to 35%
We are looking at around 170 to 180 days going forward.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Financial year '26 revenue grew to 18.9% year-on-year to INR828 crores, in line with our guided growth of ~20%
EBITDA margins were at 35.5% for FY26, surpassing our guided range of 33% to 35%

red_flags.label: Working capital days up to 170 from 124 in FY24
red_flags.quote: net working capital days was 170 days in FY26 compared to 158 days in FY25

red_flags.label: Inventory days near 200 for two years
red_flags.quote: inventory days have been running at close to 200 days for 2 years now

red_flags.label: Ambernath expenses ahead of revenue
red_flags.quote: the expenses of Ambernath have started for us, which is a very large number and the revenue from Ambernath has still not started

evasions.quote: we never guide on gross margin. So, I'll not be able to comment anything.
any product-specific prices and costing cannot be discussed in this forum.

evasions.topic: Peak revenue potential from Ambernath and Patalganga
evasions.quote: we'll not be able to guide on the full potential numbers
